name: Bulwark I
description: Reduces incoming physical attack and injury damage by 1 per hit for 60 base seconds, after armor and Stoneskin. Targets an ally or yourself. Movement speed is reduced by 25%; potency softens the slow and modestly increases protection. At +100% bonus potency, protection caps at 1.33 per hit. Strong worn armor reduces Bulwark effectiveness, to a minimum of 40%. Only one rank can be active. Does not protect against elemental damage, poison, falls or health costs.
